Select up to %1$d questions for one session.

A native Android client for studying, exams, review, and learning analytics.
Authentication is encrypted at rest. Cached private responses are removed when you sign out.
Offline — reconnect to load content or save progress. Answers are not queued.
Question and explanation must each be at most 3000 characters.
Each choice must be at most 300 characters.
Enter a daily target between 1 and 1000.
Enter a valid date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
End date must not be earlier than start date.
Delete this study plan and its recorded daily progress?
Enter a question, fill at least two choices, and select the correct answer.
Your changes have not been saved. Leave the editor and discard them?
This question changed while you were editing. Review the latest version before saving again. Your draft is preserved.
Use the server version to replace your draft, or keep your draft and review it before saving over the version shown above. Neither choice saves automatically.
Create a separate copy of this question? The new question will open after it is created.
Permanently delete this question? This action cannot be undone.
This question is used in a master exam and cannot be deleted until it is removed from that exam.
Check session status before continuing. Retry reloads server progress without resending the previous action. Unconfirmed answers may need to be entered again; if the session finished, check History.
This permanently removes the saved session and its unfinished progress.
Submit the saved answers and view results? You cannot return to answering after finishing.
The question image could not be loaded. Retry before answering if it is needed.
Refresh the bookmark list before another change. The previous request may have succeeded.
Bookmark status changed elsewhere. Review the refreshed list before removing it again.
The result uses your first answer. Your final selected choice: %1$s
No review questions are available right now. Choose material in Quizzes or refresh after studying.
Refresh the plan before saving or deleting again. Your draft is kept; the previous request may have succeeded.
No plan is saved. Choose your targets and save a plan.
Your saved plan has not started yet.
Your saved plan has ended. Update the dates to continue.
Local progress could not be secured. Retry before sending another answer. Your current text remains on this screen.
This answer is not confirmed on the server. Review it, then Retry to submit it once. No navigation or finish request will be replayed.
Server progress differs from this local draft, or its session is no longer available. Keep a copy of the text you need before discarding the draft.
Remove this local answer draft? This does not discard the saved server session.
Resume the saved session to check this local draft against server progress.
Your saved login could not be checked. Reconnect and retry; your local progress is kept.
Delete category “%1$s”? Its questions will remain without a category.
Enter non-negative whole numbers for expiry and renewal days. Leave expiry blank when editing to keep its current date.
Enter the administrator password. New users also need a username and password.
Enter a valid positive user ID.
Account access expires in %1$d day(s). Contact your administrator about renewal.
Open Quizzes and select your material. Study gives feedback after each saved answer. Exam withholds feedback until you finish. Recall asks you to think of an answer before revealing the choices.

Bookmark useful questions. Mistakes and Fragile questions help you revisit difficult material. Use the knowledge map, planner and History to follow your progress. Available actions depend on your account permissions.

A server connection is required. Wait for answer confirmation before leaving. If a request fails, use Retry and let the app check saved server progress. Unsaved answers are marked explicitly. Ordinary sessions can be paused using their pause action; closing the app does not confirm a save.

Open Master exams from More to read assignments and acknowledge them. Save each answer before changing questions. These exams keep counting down when you leave and cannot be paused. Finish submits your saved answers and opens your personal result.

The connected server processes your account details, session activity, quiz answers, results, bookmarks and reports to provide the learning service. Access depends on server permissions. Do not include identifiable patient information in questions or reports.

The app stores sign-in session cookies, preferences and supported study recovery data on this device. Session drafts use encrypted storage. Signing out clears the sign-in session and study recovery drafts; saved server records remain on the server. A shared device should be signed out after use.

This page explains the Android app data flow. Ask your system administrator for the complete policy for your deployment and for access, correction, export or deletion requests. Account deletion and server retention are managed by the administrator.
Contact your system administrator through your approved internal channel, or email hjjarmhmmdali@gmail.com. Describe the screen, action and visible error. Never send your password or session cookies.
Acknowledgement notices could not be loaded
Please read and acknowledge this exam.
I have read this exam notice
The timer continues when you leave. This exam cannot be paused. Only saved answers are submitted.
Start the timed exam now? The timer will keep running if you leave the app.
Submit saved answers and finish? Unanswered questions and unsaved edits will not earn credit. You cannot answer after finishing.
Return to the exam list? The timer continues. Saved answers remain on the server; unsaved edits on this screen will be discarded.
This attempt was finished automatically by the server.
Refresh server progress before continuing. An earlier request may have been saved.
You have an unsaved answer. Save it before navigating or finishing. After recovery it may belong to the previous question.
Report sent or awaiting confirmation. Avoid submitting the same report again.
Choose a question number. ✓ means an answer is saved. Save edits before switching questions.
Discard this unsaved answer edit? The last saved answer on the server will remain unchanged.
Enter a positive whole-number page, or leave it blank to clear it.
Source must be at most 200 characters and document at most 500.
Translate the question and optionally its explanation. Translate every choice, or leave every translated choice blank to use the base choices. Choice order follows the base question.
Enter a language code such as ar, en or en-US.
Every non-empty translation needs question text.
Complete all choices in each translation, or leave them all blank. Resolve any surplus translated choices before saving.
This translation has extra choices that do not match the base question. They have been preserved below.
Remove this language from the question draft? The change takes effect on the server only when you save.
Remove only the surplus translated choices shown below the base choice fields? Review the remaining translations before saving.
The saved answer or attempt changed on the server. Your edit is kept. Compare the saved answer, then keep your draft or discard it.
The attempt changed or already finished. Server progress has been refreshed; review it before continuing.
Use a case key up to 64 characters, a stem up to 3000 characters, and an optional positive question order. A stem or order requires a case key.
Select an existing case or enter a new key. New keys create a shared case when saved. The initial stem fills only an empty case; saving this question does not replace an existing shared stem.
Remove the case link and order from this question draft? The shared case and its other questions remain. Save the question to apply this change.
Showing %1$d of %2$d. Narrow the search to find other matches.
Choose a JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image up to 5 MiB. Uploads change the saved question immediately. Animated images show a still preview.
The image exceeds the 5 MiB limit.
This image could not be opened or decoded. Choose another file.
Choose a valid JPEG, PNG, GIF or WebP image.
The saved image or your access changed. Review the current image before confirming again.
Discard the selected image and leave? The selected file has not been uploaded.
Remove the image from the saved question now?
Upload the selected image now? It replaces any image currently attached to this question.
The last action could not be confirmed. Refresh the saved question and review its image before retrying a change. Your selected file is retained.
To attach an image, save the question, then use Manage question image in its details.
Select questions or reports on this page. Changing pages or applying a new search clears the selection.
Apply this action to %1$d selected items?
This closes the reports for review history. It does not edit or delete the reported questions.
Selected questions will be marked verified. These notes replace their existing verification notes, including when left blank.
This clears verification, verifier, verification date and verification notes for the selected questions.
Refresh and review the current results before another action. Unconfirmed writes are not retried automatically.
Add and remove these tags on the selected questions? Other tags remain. Review the refreshed tags after saving; the processed count does not mean every question changed.
Enter one tag per line, up to 50 characters each. Names are case-sensitive; surrounding spaces and duplicate lines are ignored. Commas belong to the tag name.
Enter at least one tag to add or remove.
Each tag must contain at most 50 characters.
A tag cannot be added and removed in the same action.
Some existing tag names contain commas. Leave this field unchanged to preserve them. Editing it treats commas as separators.
Enter the current admin password (up to 128 characters).
Enter a new password of 1–128 characters. The backend enforces password strength.
The new passwords do not match.
The account status changed. Review the refreshed details and confirm again.
Password reset confirmed. A password change is required at the next sign-in.
Leave and clear the password inputs? Unsubmitted inputs will be lost.
Reset the password for @%1$s now? The user must change it at the next sign-in.
Change the active status of @%1$s now? Deactivation prevents sign-in.
Refresh account details before another action. A missing response may mean the previous action was saved; password resets cannot be confirmed by reading account details alone.
Expiry is bypassed for this account.
Password change required at next sign-in.
No forced password change is currently set.
This is an external author placeholder. A password reset alone does not enable sign-in; promotion requires Django administration.
Use Change password for your own account. Self-deactivation is unavailable.
Supply and confirm a password. The backend validates its strength and requires a change at the next sign-in. No generated temporary password is requested here.
Open fresh account details and discard the current user form inputs? Save pending edits first if you want to keep them.
Accounts seen by the backend within the last five minutes. This is one entry per account, not a list of every device session. Refresh to update this snapshot.
Showing the last successful snapshot; current activity could not be refreshed.
No accounts were seen in this window.
These links show public questions available in the knowledge map. Private drafts are not included.
Refresh failed. Previously loaded content is shown; refresh successfully before opening questions or starting practice.
Practice starts with the first %1$d questions, within the configured limit.
Only the first matching cases are returned by the server. Narrow your search to find another case.
Creates an active knowledge object using this question’s category and attaches it to your draft. It is saved separately and remains if you discard the question.
Enter a title and learning objective.
Title allows 200 characters; objective and reference answer allow 3000 each.
The create request failed or its result is uncertain. Review existing objects before explicitly creating again; it may already have been saved.
Showing up to 20 matches. Compare the title and objective before attaching an existing object. Refine the title and review again if needed.
This clears the knowledge-object inputs. Your question draft is kept. Any object already saved on the server remains.
This changes the shared stem for every question linked to this case, including questions outside your visible list. Review the impact before saving.
Replace the shared stem for case %1$s and all its linked questions?
Clear the shared stem for case %1$s and all its linked questions? This does not detach or delete questions.
Leave the field blank to clear the shared stem. Questions stay linked to the case.
The shared stem allows up to 3000 characters.
The shared stem changed on the server.
Keep draft for a new confirmation
Refresh successfully and review the current stem before saving again. A failed request may already have been applied.
Shared stem saved. Visible linked questions reported by the server: %1$d.
Add one complete tag at a time. Commas are part of a tag name. Suggestions are filtered locally; refine the name to find more.
Remove all selected tags from this question draft? Other questions are unchanged.
Tag names allow up to 50 characters.
Add the typed tag or clear its input before saving the question.
Save progress and leave? You can resume this session later.
Answered correctly at least once: %1$s of %2$s
This time does not exist due to a clock change. Choose another time.
Enter positive IDs separated by commas or spaces. Leave empty to clear a list. Existing assignments are shown below their field.
Saved and confirmed by the server.

Enter a name up to 200 characters and a topic up to 100. Choose an opening time before closing; the 1–600 minute duration must fit that window. Weights must be 0.1–10 and IDs must be positive whole numbers.
The exam changed on the server. Compare the current server settings with your draft before choosing which to keep.
The previous action is unconfirmed. Refresh to read server state before making another change.
Creation is unconfirmed. Keep a copy of this draft and check the exam list before creating another exam. This request will not be retried automatically.
Server state reloaded. Review it before making another change; no previous action was resent.
Leave and discard local edits or an unconfirmed plan? Server changes may already have been saved. Check the exam list before creating another exam.
Editing is locked for this exam. The server controls its window and lifecycle.

Permanently delete this exam, its attempts, results and acknowledgements? Choose what happens to its questions. Keeping drafts leaves them private; deleting drafts removes eligible author drafts unused by other exams; publishing makes exam questions public and adds the exam tag.
Publish exam questions to the bank
Adding, removing and reordering save immediately. Removing only detaches the question from this exam.
Save or discard metadata edits before changing questions or deleting this exam.
Detach this question from the exam? The question itself will be kept.
Group search requires group administration permission. You can still edit IDs.
User search requires user administration permission. You can still edit IDs.
Apply updates the local draft. Save the exam to send these selections. Cancel keeps the previous selections.
Only member accounts appear here; co-authors also need permission to create master exams. A page can have no eligible matches; try the next page.
Selected IDs stay selected across pages and searches, even when lookup does not return them. Remove them explicitly if needed.
No eligible matches on this page.
Creates a private draft and immediately appends it to this exam. Save exam metadata first.

Enter a question up to 3000 characters, 2 or more distinct nonempty choices up to 300 characters each, and select the correct answer. Source: 200 characters; case key: 64; case stem: 3000. Case order must be a positive whole number and case fields need a case key.
The request may have created a question. Refresh and review new exam questions before discarding this local draft. Creation stays blocked; the request will not be replayed.
Draft question created. Refresh confirms its exam membership.
Review questions added since this editor opened. Another author may also have added questions; a matching question does not prove which request created it.
Discard this local copy after reviewing the server state? Any question already created remains on the server. This does not retry creation or delete a question.
This question was created but is no longer attached to the exam. It will not be recreated automatically.
Choose a nonempty file of a supported type.
This file exceeds the mobile upload limit of 50 MB.
Could not write to this document. Choose another location.
Import completed. Review the reported counts below.
File saved. You can now share it.
The import may already have committed. Review the current bank or run a fresh state preview before acknowledging. No import is retried automatically.

Replace updates matching questions and removes public questions absent from the package. Related progress can be affected. Local drafts absent from the package survive. Review the preview counts before confirming.
Import the selected file into the question bank?
Check category IDs, selected questions and PDF field lengths. Title: 150; body: 3000; field label: 60; field value: 500 characters.
Question files: JSON, CSV, XLS/XLSX. Telegram: JSON. Portable package: JSON/XLSX. Mobile upload limit: 50 MB; the server may impose a lower limit.
Review current questions and check the bank/history before deciding whether another import is needed. The server has no import receipt lookup.
Preferences apply on this device. Browsing defaults apply when opening a new list or quiz setup; restored filters and active sessions keep their settings.
Automatically advance after a saved answer and required confidence/reflection. The final question still requires Finish.
Answer click sound (respects device sound settings)
Current streak: %1$s · Longest: %2$s · Active days: %3$s · Questions: %4$s
Darker cells indicate more questions. The date list below each week gives exact session and question counts.

Published Mukhtabir privacy policy and contact details, reproduced from the frontend. Android stores preferences locally and uses temporary files for imports/exports; saved or shared files are controlled by the chosen document provider. Bundled fonts do not contact a font CDN.

Full platform reference follows the native guide above. Browser menus, keyboard shortcuts and administrative tools described here refer to the web app; Android exposes the native workflows available to your permissions.
Unsaved file choices, mappings and temporary downloads will be discarded. An import may already have changed the server; leaving does not undo it.
No application could open this share request. The saved document is still available.

Use Questions to search/filter and select material for practice. Open a question for its case context, image, source, explanation and available translations. Bookmarks keep a personal review list. The knowledge map and clinical cases provide linked material and targeted practice. Authoring and moderation actions appear only when permitted.

History contains your completed sessions and results. Mistakes, fragile knowledge and spaced repetition offer focused review. The planner tracks targets. Analytics and Study activity show confirmed activity with exact daily counts; these counts describe completed study activity, not time spent reading a screen. Member groups show the leaderboard and your visibility setting.

Settings changes theme, language, font, spacing and browsing defaults on this device. Restored filters and active sessions retain their choices. Auto-advance waits for a saved answer and required confidence/reflection and does not finish the final question. Pause/Back asks before leaving an active session. After a failed or uncertain save, use the displayed recovery action; do not assume the answer was lost. Unsaved authoring is memory-only and can be lost if the process closes.

Authorized administrators can choose question, Telegram or portable-package files using the device picker. State imports require preview, author decisions and any conflict choices; Replace also needs the administrator password and can remove public questions. Review uncertain imports before another attempt. Exports support filters or ordered selection, verified-only content and PDF layout/introduction options. Portable packages include supported bank state and optional images. Save through the document picker, then share the saved file. Temporary app files are removed when leaving the workflow or signing out; saved copies remain with the selected provider.
Select a visible exam or enter its ID. Result-view permissions are checked for this exam; access to the question-bank export tools is separate.
Generate a new temporary password for @%1$s? This replaces the current password and requires a change at the next login. Any password typed in the fields above is ignored.

Temporary password — select the text to copy it and deliver it securely. It is shown only here, kept in memory, and cannot be retrieved after leaving or restarting the app. The user must change it at the next login.
I have recorded the password; clear it

The reset response was lost or unreadable. The password may have changed, and a generated password cannot be recovered by refreshing account details. Refresh to review the account, then acknowledge this outcome before explicitly choosing another reset. No reset is retried automatically.
I understand the password may have changed
Leaving clears the temporary password and local password fields. A generated password cannot be retrieved again. Any completed or uncertain server reset remains in effect. Leave this screen?

Deletion is permanent. Linked learning history, answers, bookmarks and memberships may be removed. Users linked to questions or other protected records cannot be deleted; deactivate the account instead.

Permanently delete @%1$s and related records allowed by the server? This cannot be undone. Your current admin password is required. Users linked to questions or protected records cannot be deleted; the server also prevents deleting yourself or the last active admin.
The user no longer exists. Return to the user list to refresh it.
The main time has ended. Use the remaining grace period to save your answer. The exam will finish automatically when this countdown ends.
Turn this off to hide your results from this group leaderboard. Your learning history is kept.
No members are visible on this leaderboard.
The visibility change could not be confirmed. Refresh your groups to check the current setting before making another change.
Groups refreshed. Review the current visibility setting; the earlier change was not repeated.
The current visibility setting matches your requested change.
Reopening your last selected exam. Saved answers and results are reloaded from your account. Any encrypted pending answer is restored for review and is never sent automatically.
Encrypted exam recovery could not be read or saved. Your current draft is kept in memory. Retry storage before sending answers; discard local recovery only if you accept losing it.
Discard unreadable local exam recovery? This removes only this device’s recovery data, not server answers or results.
Finish was not confirmed. Refresh checks saved server progress without repeating Finish. Review the current state before continuing.

No exact completed result was found for the old session. It may have been discarded, or finished before exact recovery was available. Check your personal History; the app will not guess or repeat Finish.
I have reviewed the current state
Clear the unconfirmed-Finish notice after reviewing server progress or History? This does not save, finish or delete any session. Further actions require your choice.
Recheck your last exam and any encrypted pending answer. Server progress and timing are loaded before you can continue.

Finish was not confirmed. Refresh reads your attempt without repeating Finish. If the attempt is still active, review it and explicitly confirm Finish again; automatic finishing and other writes remain blocked.
Encrypted Finish recovery could not be read, saved or cleared. Further writes are blocked. Retry storage; confirmed results remain visible.

Discard unreadable local Finish recovery? This removes only the recovery record on this device. It does not finish, save or delete a server session. You must check server progress or History and explicitly review before continuing.
A previous quiz Finish was not confirmed. Reopen it to check the original session or its exact completed result without repeating Finish.
Import a connection file from your administrator or enter your server address manually below before signing in. The address is saved on this device.
For a server on your PC, use an address your phone can reach on the same network. localhost points to the phone; 10.0.2.2 is only an emulator shortcut.
For private or self-signed HTTPS, install your trusted CA certificate in Android’s certificate settings. The server certificate must match the address you enter and remain valid.
HTTP sends your password, session and learning data without encryption. Continue only if you accept this for your network.
Changing the address signs you out and disables reminders. Encrypted local downloads and recovery stay in their server profile; sign in to the same account to access them again.
Enter an http:// or https:// server address, or a full /api/v1/ address. Do not include a username, password, query or fragment.
Could not save the server setting or clear the old sign-in. Your address and local data are retained. If this address already has a separate local profile, leave the same-server option unchecked.
HTTP is permitted only for the server you selected.
The save outcome is unknown. Refresh and review the account before another save. For a new account, review the search results and acknowledge before trying again.
Days start from the time of saving. Leave blank to keep the existing expiry; 0 removes expiry.
Use finite, nonnegative weights for existing categories.
Enter a name of up to 100 characters. Save metadata separately from adding members.
Enter positive user IDs separated by commas or spaces.
Remove this member from the group? Their personal learning history is retained.
Delete this group and its memberships? Personal learning history is retained.
Delete this blueprint? It will no longer be available when starting a new exam.
Leave this editor? Unsaved changes will be lost. An unknown server outcome is not undone by leaving.
Added %1$d of %2$d requested users. Existing members and unknown IDs are skipped by the server.
The write outcome is unknown. Refresh to review server state before another write. For creation, review the list and acknowledge before trying again.
Select categories and set relative weights. Zero removes an allocation. Difficulty is chosen when starting an exam.
Opening a notice only reads exam details. Acknowledgement and starting remain separate actions.
An optional reminder on this phone, at local time. Android may delay delivery. It does not download notices or start a session.
Notifications are blocked. Allow notifications in Android settings to receive reminders.
Could not save or schedule the reminder. Try again.
Open Mukhtabir when you are ready to practise.
Your previous exam recovery is open. Review it and use Back to return to the list before opening the requested exam.
Open item #%1$d on the configured server? Sign-in and server access rules still apply.
Item #%1$d belongs to a different server. Configure that server from sign-in before opening this link.
A shared link is waiting. Return to Home or More to open it after finishing your current work.
Sessions reported by this server. Browser/device names are supplied by each client; activity is updated periodically. Password confirmation is required to end a session.
End this signed-in session? Requests already in progress may finish.
End this current session and sign out on this phone? Private local recovery and downloads will be cleared.
This session is no longer listed as active.
This session is still listed. Review it before explicitly trying again.
The outcome is unknown. Refresh and acknowledge your review before another revocation. No request is retried automatically.

Downloaded material and answers stay encrypted on this device for your account and server. Signing out clears them; changing servers keeps them in a separate profile and requires sign-in again. Offline practice has no exam timer. Login-session expiry alone does not block retained downloads.
Use distinct positive question IDs within the per-pack question limit.
Up to %1$d questions per practice pack. The full-bank option creates as many packs as storage permits. Large downloads or images can be rejected; active exam answers cannot be downloaded.
The downloaded image could not be displayed.
Choose confidence, then tap a choice to save your first answer. It cannot be changed after feedback is revealed.

Uploads first answers once into ordinary study history and learning statistics. Learning is credited when uploaded. A failed upload keeps the same completion identity for an explicit retry. Changed or inaccessible content can block upload; local results remain.
Delete this downloaded pack and its local progress? Any practice not yet uploaded will be lost. Server history already uploaded is retained.
Encrypted storage could not be read or saved. Current changes are kept in memory; repair storage before continuing. Retry never uploads answers.
Leave without repairing storage? Unsaved local changes held in memory may be lost.
There is not enough encrypted storage space for this pack. Delete an existing pack or download fewer questions. Existing progress is retained.

The password change could not be confirmed. Do not submit it again. You can sign out and try signing in with the new password; if it was not changed, use the previous password. Signing out clears downloaded material and local recovery data.
The account still requires a password change. An earlier request may still be processing. Sign out and verify which password works before making another change.
Some dashboard sections are unavailable. Refresh to try again.
One clear next step, grounded in your learning plan.
Choose a focused mode beyond today’s recommendation.
Learn with explanations after each answer.
Practise under a timer with results at the end.
Write what you remember before revealing choices.
Your learning progress and question-bank totals.
Delete this private draft permanently? The server rejects deletion while it belongs to a live exam. It will be detached from cancelled or bank-published exams.
This editor changes the fields supported by the draft endpoint. Existing images, tags, translations and other linked content are preserved. Existing shared case stems are read-only.
The outcome is unknown. Read the server state before reviewing or trying another action. The app will not resend this request automatically.
Publish this exam for its configured audience and schedule? Review the questions, timing and audience before confirming.
Cancel this exam? Participants will no longer be able to start or continue it.
Publish the attached private drafts into the public question bank and archive this exam? This action is available after the exam window closes.
Preview only. No participant attempt, score or answer is saved. The backend returns the question snapshot and answer key for authorized authors.
Open flags raised during the exam
Completed attempts only: ✓ correct · ✗ incorrect · — unanswered or unavailable. Q1, Q2… follow the exam question order. Scroll sideways for more columns.
An encrypted draft was saved for this account and server. Restore it for review or discard it. Saving still requires fresh permissions and an explicit action.
Encrypted draft storage failed. Your current work remains visible; do not rely on recovery until storage succeeds.
The previous save may have completed. Read and review the server before saving again; no request will be replayed automatically.
No unique matching exam was found. Review the management list before explicitly permitting another create action.
Encrypted on this device for the signed-in account. Logout, account changes and server changes remove access. Restore is a review action; it never submits a save.
No backups returned by the server.
The server confirmed this operation. Refresh failures below do not undo that result.

The server may have completed the operation. Review fresh database information, quality and backups, or the bank/ranks for utilities. Further operations remain blocked until you acknowledge the review. Do not assume the operation failed.
I reviewed the outcome; allow a new action
Create a backup on the server? It remains on the server and can be selected for restoration.
Replace the server database with this backup? The server makes a safety backup first. This affects all users and may invalidate sessions. Confirm with your current administrator password.

Clear question-bank content, learning history, exam and related content on the server? The server creates a safety backup and retains user accounts. This affects everyone. Confirm with your current administrator password.
Create moderation flags for reported question-bank quality issues? This action does not rewrite or automatically repair question content. Existing open quality flags are skipped by the server.
Recompute contributor trust scores and question counts on the server?
Run the server’s sample-question seeder? This is intended for demo/development data and changes the bank.
The server outcome is unknown. Keep the encrypted draft for later review. Discarding local work does not undo a server operation.
This matrix is too large for the in-app viewer. Use the CSV download to save and open it.
Permissions changed on the server. Your draft is retained. Review the current permissions before saving again.
The save outcome is unknown. Refresh to check the server before making another change.
Server permissions checked. Your draft is retained; save explicitly if you still want to apply differences.
Rating refresh failed. Existing ratings may be outdated; the question list remains available.

Move all questions and knowledge objects from “%1$s” into the category selected below, then remove the source category. Planner targets move too; overlapping blueprint weights are added. Saved session and result snapshots stay as recorded.
Choose valid source tags and a distinct name of 1–50 characters.
An ancestor cannot be merged into its descendant.
This removes the tag and its question and knowledge links. Questions remain. Children become root tags. Planner references may prevent deletion. Counts cover only visible questions.
The new name applies to the same tag across all linked questions, knowledge objects and study plans.
Source tags are removed. Their question and knowledge links, planner targets and children move to the target. A new target is created if needed. Visible counts are not global impact totals.
The change outcome needs review. Read the current server state before another write. No action is repeated automatically.
The original item is no longer accessible. This does not establish whether it was deleted.
The server item changed. Review it, then choose which draft to keep.
Keep my edits against current state
Delete this knowledge object? Linked questions remain and become unlinked. This affects the shared learning structure.
Delete this case? Its shared title and stem are removed. All linked questions remain as standalone questions.
Loaded %1$d of %2$d matches. Pages organize the loaded results; refine search to find more.
Enter one fact or misconception per line.
Check required title/objective, field lengths, source page and review date. Add pending tag text before saving.
A saved planner draft is available or needs storage review. Restore it explicitly; server changes are never replayed automatically.
Discard the encrypted planner draft? The current server plan remains.
Question impact counts could not be refreshed. Previously loaded counts may be outdated.
Question ratings could not be updated. Questions remain available.

Which structure is the basic unit of life?
Cells are the basic structural and functional units of living organisms. Similar cells form tissues; tissues form organs.
Which organ pumps blood around the body?
The heart is a muscular pump. Its contractions move blood through the pulmonary and systemic circulations.
Where does most gas exchange take place in the lungs?
Alveoli have thin walls and are surrounded by capillaries, allowing oxygen and carbon dioxide to diffuse between air and blood.
Which blood components primarily carry oxygen?
Red blood cells contain haemoglobin, which binds oxygen and carries it from the lungs to body tissues.
Which organs filter blood and produce urine?
The kidneys filter blood and regulate water and electrolyte balance. Urine carries waste and excess water out of the body.
Which part of a neuron usually receives incoming signals?
Dendrites receive most incoming signals. The axon carries signals away from the cell body toward other cells.
Beta cells in the pancreatic islets produce insulin, a hormone that helps regulate blood glucose.
Where is most nutrient absorption completed?
The small intestine has a large absorptive surface created by folds, villi and microvilli. It absorbs most digested nutrients.
